title: Marine's Airport Meltdown After Cop's Insult – Misses Flight in Chaos!
description:
On December 23rd, 2023, officers in Washington were called to an airport following reports of a disturbance near the Alaska Airlines ticketing area. Upon arrival, officers encountered a visibly agitated man matching the suspect description provided by dispatch. The man, wearing a tie-dye sweatshirt, was seen yelling at airline employees and causing a significant disturbance. Officers attempted to calm the suspect, who maintained hostility and aggressive behavior with officers, including verbal threats and positioning as if preparing to fight.

The suspect, a former Marine, was reportedly upset after being told he could not board his flight due to arriving too late. He repeatedly mentioned his military background and became increasingly angry by being called "cowboy" by an officer.
 The situation escalated as the suspect continued to resist officers' attempts to de-escalate and detain him. Despite multiple officers on the scene, the suspect refused to comply with commands, leading to a physical altercation. The situation escalated as the suspect struck one of the officers, prompting them to restrain the suspect and place him under arrest.

Ultimately, the suspect was handcuffed and escorted by officers to a patrol car for transport. During this process, the suspect continued to display erratic behavior and made further threats towards the officers. The suspect was charged with Assault on a Police Officer and Resisting Arrest.
